C1433.title: Solana Network Outage Caused by Spam Transaction Attack
C1433.summary: On September 14, 2021, the Solana network suffered a spam transaction attack that caused an outage of approximately 17 hours. When Grape Protocol launched its IDO on Raydium, bots generated massive volumes of transactions that flooded the network, causing a memory overflow that crashed many validators and prevented the network from reaching consensus on the current blockchain state, blocking new block finalization. Attackers used massive low-value transactions to mount a distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attack, a typical spam transaction and network congestion attack.
